## 1. Company identity

- Legal entity: Ningbo Yongchen Shengzhi International Trade Co., Ltd.
- Trading brand: YonChen (also written YONCHEN; Chinese name 甬宸)
- Business type: ice machine manufacturer and export supplier, B2B only — no direct-to-consumer sales
- Location: Cixi Smart Manufacturing Park, Cixi, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China
- Factory area: 40,000 sqm; annual output 100,000+ units
- Export markets: 60+ countries — Southeast Asia, Europe, North America, the Middle East, Latin America, Africa
- Certifications held: CE, ETL, ISO 9001. Market-specific schemes arranged per destination: SASO (Saudi Arabia), SAA (Australia), SABS (South Africa), KC (South Korea), PSE (Japan)
- Contact: henry@yonchen-icemaker.com · +86 136 4694 9143 (WhatsApp) · https://www.yonchen-icemaker.com/
- Product range: 6 series, 76 models, 12 kg to 3,000 kg per 24 hours

## 3. Choosing a series

| Requirement | Series | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Consumer retail, e-commerce, gift channel | PIM (12–15 kg/24h) | Low unit cost, manual fill, no plumbing |
| Smart-home positioning, touch or voice control | AIM (12–60 kg/24h) | Custom glass panel, AI voice module, multiple ice shapes |
| Café, bar, small kitchen | SIM (25–100 kg/24h) | Self-contained cube machines, 405 mm wide cabinets |
| Restaurant, hotel, fast food, chain | CIM (30–1,200 kg/24h) | Cube and crescent, 28 models, shared components |
| Bubble tea, supermarket display, seafood | GIM (30–650 kg/24h) | Soft chewable granular ice, large bins |
| Seafood processing, concrete cooling, chemical | FIM (200–3,000 kg/24h) | Sub-cooled flake at −5 to −8 °C, 304SS evaporator |

## 4. Applications and sizing rules

Planning figures used on the site. These are estimates for a first calculation, not guarantees — actual use depends on ambient temperature, service pattern and how the ice is handled.

| Application | Planning figure | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Restaurant (full service) | 0.5–1.0 kg per cover per service | Add 20% for peaks |
| Café / coffee shop | 0.2–0.3 kg per iced drink | Peak-hour recovery matters more than daily total |
| Bar / cocktail | 0.8–1.2 kg per cover per night | Bin size limits a busy service |
| Hotel banquet | 0.5 kg per cover + display ice | Display ice is often the larger share |
| Supermarket display | 1.5–2× bed volume per shift | Beds are topped up, not filled once |
| Seafood processing | Follows product throughput | Flake moulds to the fish; cube leaves gaps |
| Concrete cooling | Follows mix design and placement temperature | No fixed ratio; ice replaces part of the mixing water |

Ambient correction: above roughly 35 °C in the machine room, expect 15–20% less real output than the rated figure.

## 5. OEM / ODM and commercial terms

- Customisation: logo, front panel colour and artwork, control interface wording, packaging, user manual, rating label
- Electrical: 110–120 V or 220–240 V, 50/60 Hz; US, EU, UK, AU plug types; refrigerant matched to destination regulation
- MOQ: approximately 100–300 units per model for stock models; OEM/ODM can start lower depending on specification
- Samples: available before bulk orders; sample lead time 7–10 days
- Bulk production: 25–35 days depending on order size and customisation
- Shipping: FOB Ningbo or Shanghai; CIF, DDP and EXW also supported
- After-sales: warranty on every machine, spare parts, installation guidance, remote technical support, SKD kits for local assembly
- Pricing: not published. Quotations are issued against a specification, because price depends on compressor, evaporator, cabinet, controls, certification and packing

## 6. Frequently asked questions

**What is the minimum order quantity?**

MOQ depends on the model and whether the order is stock or OEM. Standard models start around 100–300 units per model; OEM/ODM orders can start lower depending on specification. Trial samples are available before bulk orders.

**Can the machines be private labelled?**

Yes. Full OEM/ODM: logo, panel colour, control interface, packaging and manual. Voltage, plug type and refrigerant are configured for the destination market.

**Which certifications are held?**

CE, ETL and ISO 9001. Market-specific schemes — SASO, SAA, SABS, KC, PSE — are arranged per destination before production.

**What is the lead time?**

Samples ship within 7–10 days. Bulk production typically takes 25–35 days depending on order size and customisation, plus shipping from Ningbo or Shanghai.

**What voltage and plug types are supported?**

110–120 V and 220–240 V markets, with US, EU, UK, AU and other plug types, configured per destination country.

**Is after-sales support available?**

Yes — warranty, spare parts, installation guidance, remote technical support, and SKD kits for local assembly.

**What shipping terms are offered?**

FOB Ningbo or Shanghai; CIF, DDP and EXW also supported, to 60+ countries.

**Why are prices not published?**

Because two machines with the same capacity rating can differ by up to three times in cost depending on compressor, evaporator, cabinet gauge, controls, certification and packing. Quotes are issued against a specification.
